g.text: Apple MacBook Pro (16-inch, M4 Pro, Nov 2024) · apple,t6040 · kernel 7.3.0-aurora-fleet10 · stage2 1.0.0b1 · system firmware 27.0
Fan speeds change with `aurora-diag fan set N RPM` (guarded, journalled, auto-restored) once the kernel allows it (macsmc_hwmon fan_control). Writes from
here: select a fan target on Sensors and press e.
